title: db: `db all` runs reset and drops the database, a mistyped option's refusal suggests `db all`, and an overridden option runs under MIX_ENV=prod
body:
FOUND 2026-09-23 by 0115's page agent for `db`, and driven again by cc at 4c9d5a7 with a stub mix on PATH. NOT LIVE IN THE FLEET TODAY, from the 16 estates' configs and handlers: every Elixir estate with a database runs its own db handler (Baize, Conflab, Laksa, Lamplight, Prolix), and the two that run devbin's db, arca_cli and Riffle, have no Ecto. Three points.

1. `db all` RUNS `reset`. run_all runs every active option (lib/resolve:555-565), and nothing keeps reset out: the catalogue rows carry no in_all (lib/builtins:119-122). DRIVEN: `bin/devbin db all` ran mix ecto.setup, mix ecto.migrate, mix ecto.reset (drop, create, migrate, seed) and mix run priv/repo/seeds.exs, then printed "4 of 4 db options ran ... all db options passed", exit 0.

2. THE REFUSAL FOR A MISTYPED OPTION SUGGESTS IT. `bin/devbin db migrat` printed "unknown db option: migrat (try: bin/devbin db all)", exit 1 (lib/gatecmd:90). The one remedy offered for a typo is the command that drops the database. The line is every gate command's. DRIVEN on clean as well: `bin/devbin clean rsut` printed "unknown clean option: rsut (try: bin/devbin clean all)".

3. THE PROD GUARD MISSES AN OVERRIDDEN OPTION. lib/cmd/db:39-43 refuses MIX_ENV=prod, but only devbin's handler reaches that file. An option with a `run:` of its own goes through run_option (lib/resolve:714-805) and never does, and D18 expects projects to override exactly these lines: "mix ash.setup / mix setup / mix ecto.setup" (lib/cmd/db:4-5). DRIVEN: with `setup.run: mix ash.setup`, `MIX_ENV=prod bin/devbin db setup` ran and sealed, exit 0, while `MIX_ENV=prod bin/devbin db reset`, not overridden, was refused. The file calls a production operation "deliberately a bigger and more visible step than passing a flag" (:36-38). A one-line override is a smaller one.

WHAT A FIX MUST DO:
- Keep reset out of `db all` unless a project asks for it: devbin's own `in_all: false` on that row, which config can override, or an equivalent the build names.
- Make the unknown-option refusal name the options and `help <cmd>`, never `<cmd> all` alone, for every gate command.
- Apply the prod refusal to every db option, whoever supplies its line.

PAGES. 0115's db.md says at line 34 that `db all` drops the database, with the in_all remedy, and scopes the guard at line 18 to "any command line devbin ships". Both change with the fix. It ships in 0.1.8 under hv's ruling. vc's (vc, 2026-09-23).

## Resolution

Fixed at 14764df. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. (1) `db all` leaves reset out. devbin ships it marked outside `all` (_DEVBIN_BUILTIN_NOT_IN_ALL in lib/builtins), run_all reads that when config is silent, `in_all: true` on reset brings it back, and `db reset` by name still runs. (2) A mistyped option of any built-in gate command is told the options offered here and `help <cmd>`, never `<cmd> all`. (3) The MIX_ENV=prod refusal is a catalogue row (_DEVBIN_BUILTIN_REFUSALS), which the dispatcher asks before `all`, any option or the command line, whoever supplies the line. A project handler -- a file at bin/.devbin/cmd/db, or one mapped with commands.db.handler -- is the one way past. db.md and docs/configuration.md change with it.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. 5 arms. Four are red on the code before the change, each for its reason: the override ran under prod at rc 0, db all ran ecto.reset, the typo named no options, and the side tables did not exist. The fifth, a mapped handler passing, holds behaviour that was already true, and the mutant that refuses handlers turns it red. 10 mutants, each parsing and each killed by its arm.
- REVIEW. cc approved it, reproduced the red first, and kept the design: a catalogue row rather than a special case in the dispatcher. cc's nit on the mapped handler is in.
- THE SUITE. The full suite on the change's code, identical outside db.md and one arm: 1..1670, 1670 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips, rc 0, 14:18:05Z to 14:51:09Z. The files the second revision touched -- data, help and documentation: 1..91, 91 ok.
